title: Custom IAM policies must allow CreateVolume from snapshots (#2190)

detection.reason: the controller's IAM policy is AWS-side; IRSA shows only the role ARN and EKS Pod Identity nothing at all

quote: Due to an upcoming change in handling of IAM polices for the CreateVolume API when creating a volume from an EBS snapshot, a change to your EBS CSI Driver policy may be needed.
remediation: If the controller's role uses the AWS-managed AmazonEBSCSIDriverPolicy, nothing to do (AWS updated it in every partition on 2025-01-13). With a custom policy, apply the change in GitHub issue #2190: CreateVolume from a snapshot is now authorized against the snapshot resource as well, so add a statement allowing ec2:CreateVolume on arn:aws:ec2:*:*:snapshot/* with no tag condition (upstream's example policy). Upstream: this applies to every driver version, upgraded or not.
verifyCommand: kubectl get sa -A -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(.metadata.name == "ebs-csi-controller-sa") | "\(.metadata.namespace): \(.metadata.annotations["eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn"] // "no IRSA annotation")"'  # prints the controller's IRSA role; with none, aws eks list-pod-identity-associations --cluster-name CLUSTER_NAME --service-account ebs-csi-controller-sa names the Pod Identity role; list its policies with aws iam list-attached-role-policies --role-name ROLE_NAME
